mapper.sql: E.EMP_NO, E.EMP_NM, E.DEPT_CD, D.DEPT_NM, E.POS_CD, E.HIRE_DT, E.EMAIL
mapper.select:
SELECT , C.CD_NM AS POS_NM FROM TB_EMP E JOIN TB_DEPT D ON D.DEPT_CD = E.DEPT_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CODE C ON C.GRP_CD = 'POS' AND C.CD = E.POS_CD WHERE E.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND E.EMP_NM LIKE '%' || #{empNm} || '%'
AND E.DEPT_CD = #{deptCd}
AND E.HIRE_DT >= REPLACE(#{hireFrom}, '-', '')
AND E.HIRE_DT <= REPLACE(#{hireTo}, '-', '')
ORDER BY E.EMP_NO

SELECT E.EMP_NO, E.EMP_NM, D.DEPT_NM FROM TB_EMP E, TB_DEPT D WHERE E.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD AND E.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND (E.EMP_NM LIKE '%' || #{empNm} || '%' OR E.EMP_NO = #{empNm})
SELECT FROM TB_EMP E JOIN TB_DEPT D ON D.DEPT_CD = E.DEPT_CD WHERE E.EMP_NO = #{empNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EMP_HIST (HIST_SEQ, EMP_NO, CHG_DT, CHG_ID, CHG_TYPE, BEFORE_JSON) SELECT SEQ_EMP_HIST.NEXTVAL, E.EMP_NO, SYSDATE, #{regId}, #{rowStatus}, E.EMP_NM || '|' || E.DEPT_CD || '|' || E.POS_CD FROM TB_EMP E WHERE E.EMP_NO = #{empNo}
